newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Monday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Monday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Monday:
Spokesman Nikolaus van der Pas said spokesman Nicolaas Wegter would brief journalists at 1700/1600 GMT in his office on U.S. mediator for Cyprus Carey Cavanaugh's visit.

Spokesman Josep Coll i Carbo briefed on Guatemala President Alvaro Arzu's visit to Brussels on Tuesday. He said he would meet Commission President Jacques Santer and Commissioner Manuel Marin for breakfast and then attend the Inter-American Development Bank and the European Commission donors conference starting at 0930/0830 GMT with an opening address by Commissioner Marin. He said Arzu and Marin would hold a joint news conference at 1100/1000 GMT in the Breydel news room.
Coll i Carbo said the donors conference would continue on Wednesday and would end with a news conference.

Spokeswoman Barbara Nolan said there would be a conference on social policy and economic performance in Amsterdam starting Thursday evening and ending Saturday at lunchtime, organised by the Dutch ministry of Social Affairs and employment in cooperation with the Commission. She said speakers would include Commissioner Padraig Flynn, former Sanish Prime Minister Felipe Gonzalez, former Commission President Jacques Delors and former Dutch Prime Minister Ruud Lubbers.
Nolan also said Commissioner Flynn had had a very constructive meeting with Italian Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi at 1000/0900 GMT. She said she would provide further details in her office.

In answer to a question spokesman Gerry Kiely said Commissioner Franz Fischler was speaking in his personnal capacity when, in a speech in Berlin on Saturday, he said 2003 was the most realistic date for the accession of Eastern and Central European countries to the EU.

Kiely said the ban on marketing of unsafe cosmetic products had been decided by Commission written procedure last week following a Scientific Committee opinion. He said it was only formalising something that had existed for about five years. Van der Pas added that it still had to be transposed into national legislation by July.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/25: Commission report shows a link between employee financial participation and productivity.
- IP/97/26: Tadjikistan: European Commission approves aid package worth Ecu 2.46 million.
- IP/97/27: BSE: the Commission introduces a legal ban on the placing on the market of unsafe cosmetic products.
- IP/97/28: Statement by Commissioner Emma Bonino on murder of three Spanish volunteers in Rwanda.
- Speech/97/9: Speech by Commissioner Franz Fischler on Enlargment, political approach and economic cooperation between Eastern Europe and the EU.
- Eurostat - Population and social conditions - Asylum Seekers No 1996-2: Asylum seekers in Europe in the first six months of 1996.
- Press relesase on the "Social policy and economic performance Conference" in Amsterdam.
- Agenda for the "Social policy and economic performance Conference" in Amsterdam.
